scope: Chapter excerpt on JES/JER from the hadronic W in single-lepton ttbar. Not a full dissertation. No numerical grade.

findings.title: Half-maximum is not a 1σ statistical interval
findings.explanation: Section 6.2 defines the statistical uncertainty as the distance from the likelihood maximum to the half-maximum point, and states that this corresponds to one σ. For a Gaussian likelihood the 1σ point is L = Lmax·exp(−1/2) ≈ 0.607 Lmax, i.e. −2ΔlnL = 1. Half-maximum is −2ΔlnL = 2 ln 2 ≈ 1.386, about 1.18σ if the likelihood is parabolic.
findings.recommendation: Redefine the statistical error at −2ΔlnL = 1 and state whether the quoted number is the half-width or a one-sided difference. Use that definition for every s_i and r_i.
findings.suggestedRevision: The statistical uncertainty is the shift of the correction factor at which −2ΔlnL = 1, corresponding to a 68% interval for a parabolic likelihood. It is not the half-maximum point.

evidence.quote:
The statistical uncertainty is obtained as the
difference between the correction factors for which the likelihood is maximised and the
ones for which the likelihood is half of the maximum value (which corresponds to one σ
variation).
evidence.exactQuote:

findings.title: JER uncertainty sentence contradicts Table 7.2
findings.explanation: The prose says the JER uncertainty ranges from 14 to 22% over the whole pT range. Table 7.2 lists total uncertainties of 0.225 (Run 2) and 0.281 (Run 3) in the 150–200 GeV bin, and 0.235 in the Run 3 20–35 GeV bin.
findings.recommendation: Replace the sentence with the range in Table 7.2, and do not describe the 150–200 GeV bin as a 22% constraint.

findings.title: Pseudo-experiments do not state that they use the Hessian covariance
findings.explanation: The bands in Figures 7.1 and 7.2 come from pseudo-experiments that sample each correction factor from a Gaussian of its total uncertainty. Section 7.2 separately reports off-diagonal correlations from the inverse Hessian, including a large anti-correlation of s_1 with s_2 and s_3. The pseudo-experiment paragraph does not say the draws are multivariate.
findings.recommendation: State that each toy is drawn from the covariance at the minimum, or show that independent draws do not move the μ bands. Independent draws would mis-estimate the off-diagonal regions.

findings.title: Data-scale factor 1/s is stated, its uncertainty is not propagated
findings.explanation: The factors are fitted on simulation, and the text says the inverse must be applied to data. Table 7.1 quotes s and σ_s. σ(1/s) = σ_s/s². For Run 2, 20–35 GeV, s = 0.929 and σ_s = 0.0783, so 1/s = 1.076 and σ(1/s) = 0.091, about 16% larger than the tabulated total.
findings.recommendation: Add a data-scale column to Table 7.1, or state that the published uncertainty is the MC-scale one and give the propagation for the bin farthest from unity.

findings.title: Missing JER smearing is assigned to an unresolved systematic section
findings.explanation: The in situ JER smearing has not been derived for the current reconstruction release and is not applied. The text says the difference is covered by the systematic uncertainties, which are cited as Section ?? and Chapter ??. This copy has 44 unresolved cross-references, including a literal sec:background label.
findings.recommendation: Resolve the cross-references and show, in this chapter, the size of the systematic that replaces the missing smearing in each pT bin.

findings.title: JES and JER are varied and fitted separately
findings.explanation: Templates set r = 1 while varying s, and the two extractions are separate likelihoods. A mean shift and a width shift of the same peak are not independent. The chapter says the other uncertainty is promoted to a systematic, but that procedure is cited into an unresolved chapter.
findings.recommendation: Show either a joint (s, r) fit in one region or the shift in s when r is moved by its total uncertainty, with the number written in this chapter.

findings.title: The 20–35 GeV JES central value is not a significant deviation
findings.explanation: Table 7.1 gives s = 0.929 ± 0.0783 in the lowest Run 2 bin, which is about 0.9σ from unity. The mid-pT Run 2 bins are 2–2.7σ from unity. The diagonal 20–35 GeV region is excluded, and s_1 is estimated only from off-diagonal regions. The 5(7)% sentence describes the uncertainty, not the significance.
findings.recommendation: Put the off-diagonal-only constraint in the Table 7.1 caption, and discuss significance using the total uncertainty, not the central value alone. Apply the same statement to JER: every r_i is within 1σ of unity under the total uncertainty.

findings.title: The usable correction and a closure test are not in this chapter
findings.explanation: The factors are derived in discrete bins. The text says a continuous function will be constructed later by interpolation. The extracted chapter does not describe a closure test in which an injected s_i is recovered. Section 7.3 compares post-fit templates to data, which does not replace that test.
findings.recommendation: Include the interpolation and a closure test, particularly for s_1, before these factors are applied as a calibration.

findings.title: Background fraction is inclusive, and the background section is unresolved
findings.explanation: After the χ² < 1 requirement, 5% of selected simulated events in the inclusive region are background, dominated by tW. The detailed description is cited as Section ??, and the introduction still contains the unresolved label sec:background. The 5% figure is not given per pT bin.
findings.recommendation: Give the background fraction in each analysis region in this chapter. The low-pT bin is where the calibration uncertainty is largest.

findings.title: The 150–200 GeV JER factor is not a diagonal measurement
findings.explanation: Section 6.1 excludes the 150–200 GeV diagonal region from the JER fit because the templates do not separate. Table 7.2 still quotes r = 0.997 ± 0.225 (Run 2) and 0.995 ± 0.281 (Run 3) for that bin. The correlation text explains the analogous off-diagonal-only constraint for s_1, not for this r.
findings.recommendation: State in the Table 7.2 caption that this bin is constrained only by off-diagonal regions, and that the diagonal region was excluded for lack of template separation.

findings.title: Off-diagonal approximations are disclosed but not quantified
findings.explanation: Off-diagonal events are selected at the sub-leading jet factor only. If the jet indices at s_1 and s_2 disagree, the s_2 set is used. The b-jet in the chi-squared re-evaluation is left unfolded when it is in a different pT bin. MC retains 15–20 GeV jets so folding can move them across the 20 GeV data threshold. None of these rates is given.
findings.recommendation: Quote the fraction of events whose index set changes and whose b-jet is left unfolded, and state that post-folding MC is cut at the same 20 GeV threshold as data.

findings.title: The method is specified, and the prior art is acknowledged
findings.explanation: The chapter cites the pre-Run-1 proposal and the 7 TeV cross-check, specifies the ΔR = 0.2 match, reports a matching efficiency that reaches about 100% in the highest diagonal bins after χ² < 1, and explains the s_1 anti-correlation from the excluded diagonal region.
findings.recommendation: Keep these statements next to the corresponding tables when the unresolved cross-references are repaired.

defenseQuestions.question: Why is the statistical uncertainty defined at half the maximum likelihood rather than at −2ΔlnL = 1?
defenseQuestions.motivation: The text equates the half-maximum point with one σ.

defenseQuestions.question: Are the pseudo-experiments drawn from the Hessian covariance, or from an independent Gaussian per bin?
defenseQuestions.motivation: The band construction and the correlation paragraph do not refer to each other.

defenseQuestions.question: Which systematic component replaces the in situ JER smearing that has not been derived for this release, and how large is it in the 20–35 GeV bin?
defenseQuestions.motivation: The smearing is omitted and the systematic section is an unresolved cross-reference.

defenseQuestions.question: What does a closure test return for an injected s_1, given that the 20–35 GeV diagonal region is excluded?
defenseQuestions.motivation: No closure test is described in this chapter.

defenseQuestions.question: Confirm that the factor applied to data is 1/s, and show σ(1/s) for the Run 2 20–35 GeV bin.
defenseQuestions.motivation: The inverse is required by the text, but Table 7.1 is still in the MC convention.
